run_evaluate_speech_enhancement: run the denoiser evaluation module to compute PESQ and STOI metrics on a test dataset
run_get_pesq: run the get_pesq function to calculate PESQ scores between reference and enhanced audio signals
run_get_stoi: run the get_stoi function to calculate STOI scores between reference and enhanced audio signals
run_evaluate_with_model: run the evaluate function with a custom model and data loader to get PESQ and STOI metrics
run_run_metrics: run the _run_metrics function to compute PESQ and STOI on clean and estimated audio tensors
